course.title: Unit 5 Food we eat-Part C--【例句】

sentences.content: First, we plant the seed in spring or autumn.
sentences.english: First , we plant the seed in spring or autumn
sentences.chinese: 首先，我们在春季或秋季播种。

sentences.content: Then a sprout will grow from the seed.
sentences.english: Then a sprout will grow from the seed
sentences.chinese: 然后种子就会发芽生长。

sentences.content: Next, the root will grow big and strong.
sentences.english: Next , the root will grow big and strong
sentences.chinese: 接下来，根部会变得又大又壮。

sentences.content: We eat this part of a carrot.
sentences.english: We eat this part of a carrot
sentences.chinese: 我们吃胡萝卜的这个部分。

sentences.content: Finally, we will pull up the carrot by the stem and leaves.
sentences.english: Finally , we will pull up the carrot by the stem and leaves
sentences.chinese: 最后，我们将抓住胡萝卜的茎叶将其拔起。

wordDetails.definition: pull up（短语动词）: 拔出

sentences.content: Choose a plant you want to talk about.
sentences.english: Choose a plant you want to talk about
sentences.chinese: 选择一种你想谈论的植物。

sentences.content: Draw some pictures to help you.
sentences.english: Draw some pictures to help you
sentences.chinese: 画一些图来帮助你。

sentences.content: Write a draft.
sentences.english: Write a draft
sentences.chinese: 起草一份草稿。

sentences.content: Where does it / do they come from?
sentences.english: Where does it / do they come from ?
sentences.chinese: 它/它们来自哪里？

sentences.content: The history of tea
sentences.english: The history of tea
sentences.chinese: 茶的历史

sentences.content: At first, people didn't drink tea.
sentences.english: At first , people didn't drink tea
sentences.chinese: 起初，人们并不喝茶。

sentences.content: But they did eat tea leaves!
sentences.english: But they did eat tea leaves !
sentences.chinese: 但他们确实吃了茶叶！

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句或否定句

sentences.content: Later, more people began to drink tea.
sentences.english: Later , more people began to drink tea
sentences.chinese: 后来，越来越多的人开始喝茶。

sentences.content: There were many different kinds of tea.
sentences.english: There were many different kinds of tea
sentences.chinese: 茶的种类繁多。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: People put tea leaves in hot water to make a drink.
sentences.english: People put tea leaves in hot water to make a drink
sentences.chinese: 人们将茶叶放入热水中制成饮品。

sentences.content: Tea was first popular in China.
sentences.english: Tea was first popular in China
sentences.chinese: 茶最初在中国流行起来。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: Then it travelled to Japan and other countries.
sentences.english: Then it travelled to Japan and other countries
sentences.chinese: 随后它传到了日本和其他国家。

sentences.content: In the 1700s, tea became popular in the UK.
sentences.english: In the 1700s , tea became popular in the UK
sentences.chinese: 18世纪时，茶饮在英国开始流行。

sentences.content: In China, some people like to cook chicken and eggs with tea leaves.
sentences.english: In China , some people like to cook chicken and eggs with tea leaves
sentences.chinese: 在中国，有些人喜欢用茶叶烹制鸡肉和鸡蛋。

sentences.content: They make cakes and ice cream with tea too!
sentences.english: They make cakes and ice cream with tea too !
sentences.chinese: 他们还会用茶来制作蛋糕和冰淇淋！

sentences.content: Now, tea is popular all over the world.
sentences.english: Now , tea is popular all over the world
sentences.chinese: 如今，茶饮风靡全球。

sentences.content: There is green tea, black tea, flower tea .
sentences.english: There is green tea , black tea , flower tea
sentences.chinese: 有绿茶、红茶、花茶。

sentences.content: There really is a tea for everyone!
sentences.english: There really is a tea for everyone !
sentences.chinese: 总有一款茶适合您！

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是

sentences.content: Where does tea come from?
sentences.english: Where does tea come from ?
sentences.chinese: 茶源自何处？

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 来自

sentences.content: Most tea comes from China!
sentences.english: Most tea comes from China !
sentences.chinese: 大多数茶叶产自中国！

wordDetails.definition: come（第三人称单数）: 来自
